posts.title: Still Life Photography at Home: Turning Everyday Objects into Art
posts.description: When the weather turns cold and the days get short, your next great photograph might be sitting on the kitchen table. Still life photography is one of the oldest genres in visual art, and it remains one of the most instructive. posts.title: Less in the Frame: Minimalist Photography for Quiet Seasons
posts.description: By November, the landscape has been stripped back. Leaves are down, colors have faded to browns and greys, and the busy abundance of summer is gone. Many photographers treat this as the dead season. It’s actually an invitation. posts.title: Dark and Moody Photography: Creating Eerie Atmosphere for Halloween
posts.description: Halloween gives photographers permission to lean into the shadows. But the most unsettling images rarely depend on costumes or plastic skeletons. They depend on atmosphere: a doorway that drops into darkness, a face half lit from below, an empty corridor with one light left on.
